name: smwmusic-immaculate-sense-in-darkness-eyes-shut
title: Immaculate Sense in Darkness ~ Eyes Shut
description:
It's the Touhou-inspired original entry for Super Famicompo #8 from Archbishop Weeble-Wobble & Hooded Edge that got 4th Place.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("S-550 LA Tom.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. F# Minor w/ Slight Detune (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. G Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
ㅤ4. F Minor (Custom Pitch 3)
